The request goes from `markPatientDeceased` in the chart to a `POST /ws/rest/v1/person/{uuid}`. The REST resource then calls `PersonService.savePerson`, which hands the Person to `HibernatePersonDAO.savePerson` and saves it through Hibernate.

1. **Frontend trigger.** The "Mark patient deceased" overflow item launches the workspace, and the workspace form calls `markPatientDeceased(...)` at `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/mark-patient-deceased/mark-patient-deceased-form.workspace.tsx:118`. The menu item is in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/mark-patient-deceased.component.tsx:13-33`.

2. **Frontend request.** `markPatientDeceased` in `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-chart-app/src/data.resource.ts:52-78` builds the payload `{dead: true, deathDate, causeOfDeath | causeOfDeathNonCoded}`. It passes it to `changePatientDeathStatus` (lines 39-50), which POSTs to `${restBaseUrl}/person/${personUuid}` with `openmrsFetch`.

3. **Server REST handler.** `PersonResource1_8.save(Person)` in `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/PersonResource1_8.java:411-417` calls `Context.getPersonService().savePerson(person)`. The `dead`, `deathDate` and `causeOfDeath` properties are declared on this resource (lines 121-123 and 145-147), but I did not read the generic property-setting code that copies them onto the Person. That step is inferred, not verified.

4. **Core service.** `PersonServiceImpl.savePerson` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/PersonServiceImpl.java:302-310` sets the preferred name and address, then calls `dao.savePerson(person)`. The interface is `PersonService.java:712`.

5. **Data access.** `HibernatePersonDAO.savePerson` in `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernatePersonDAO.java:601-603` calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate(sessionFactory.getCurrentSession(), person)`. The DAO interface is `PersonDAO.java:112`.

I did not read the `mark-patient-deceased-form.workspace.tsx` file, so the form-side details come only from the call site. The chart checkout has no repository-level `patient` endpoint in this path; the marking goes through the `person` resource.
